name: lunar-dither
title: Lunar Dither
description: A cratered moon printed as an 8×8 Bayer dither, lit by the pointer. Click to drop meteors.

props.description: A div with role img that owns one Canvas. Size it with className.

props.name: ink
props.description: Shadow tone. Any three.js color string.

props.name: paper
props.description: Light tone.

props.name: pixelSize
props.description: Bayer cell in CSS px.

props.name: grain
props.description: Film grain, 0 to 1. 0 turns it off.

props.name: craterScale
props.description: Crater density. Higher is smaller and busier.

props.name: rotationSpeed
props.description: Spin in radians per second.

props.name: followPointer
props.description: The light eases toward the pointer.

props.name: lightDirection
props.description: Resting light direction in view space, used while followPointer is false. Point it at the viewer for a full moon.

props.name: paused
props.description: Holds the frame and stops rendering.

props.name: impacts
props.description: Clicking the moon drops a meteor and leaves a crater where it hit.

props.name: maxImpacts
props.description: Craters kept, 1 to 64. The next impact overwrites the oldest.

props.name: onImpact
props.description: Called on each hit with the crater center on the unit sphere, in the moon's object space.

props.name: label
props.default: "A cratered moon printed as an ordered dither"
props.description: Accessible name.

props.name: className
props.description: Give the moon a size.
Camera and moon without the Canvas. Mount it alone in a Canvas or a drei View.

accessibility: A role img element with an accessible name. The canvas is hidden from assistive tech.
Without WebGL it shows a static gradient disc in the same two tones.
Bombarding is pointer only and decorative. Nothing depends on it, so there is no keyboard path.

animation.timing: Always while visible, on demand offscreen or paused

animation.reducedMotion: No easing, no spin, frozen grain.

animation.timing: 180 ms flight, then a flash and a 600 ms shockwave ring
animation.trigger: Click or tap on the moon
animation.reducedMotion: No streak or ring. The crater appears at once in one frame.

docs: Requires React 19. Render <LunarDither className="h-96 w-96" /> anywhere. LunarDither owns a Canvas, so mount LunarDitherScene inside an existing Canvas or drei View when a page already has one. Click the moon to bombard it; pass impacts={false} to turn that off.
